description: Run a JavaScript regular expression against text: every match with its index, length, numbered and named capture groups, plus an optional replace preview ($1, $<name>, $&, $`, $', $$). Flags g i m s u y (and d, v). Runs in an isolated worker with a timeout (default 1.5 s) so catastrophic backtracking is reported instead of hanging. Lists up to 5000 matches. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/regex-playground/

limit.description: Max matches to include in the result (count is still total). Default 500.

pattern.description: The regex source, without slashes, e.g. "(\\d+)-(?<w>[a-z]+)".

replace.description: Replacement string for a replace preview (JavaScript String.replace syntax).

timeoutMs.description: Kill the regex after this many ms. Default 1500.

name: regex_test
title: Regex test
